violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Noodles=44F, cooked shrimp,mop= 44F, raw steak= 44F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CORRECTED (REPLACED)

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: The two-drawer refrigerator located under the flat top grill.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation System, No Hazard/Nuisance/Unlawful Discharge
violations.observation: Ventilation systems to the restroom was noted top be make a loud sound , when the lights are turned on, creating a nuisance.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the vent in the restroom, if it cannot be repaired, replace it.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the front serving/cook-line, was being used to store small;, utensils such as a hand held slicer.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used ONLY for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands.CORRECTED DURING TYHE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: LOMEIN=120F, STEAMED VEGGIES=99F, SPRING ROLL=116F, DUMPLING=108F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. All items were reheated to above 165F, during the inspection.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: observed unmarked bottles with hard-to-identify foods were not labeled to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed unmarked spray bottles without labels top identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: salt, flour, oil, spices, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Laundered
violations.observation: Wiping cloths improperly stored between use, not in chemical sanitizing solution, in the following locations:
violations.corrective_action: Cloths in use for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces shall be laundered daily. After each use, soak wet wiping towels in sanitizing solutions. Do not leave the towels on work tables.
